name: A Date with a Vampire
source:
You play as Danielle, an up and coming journalist who starts a new life in a small town to focus on her career. Though, unbeknownst to Danielle, her neighbors are beautiful vampires!

[From [url=https://buttercreambunnystudio.itch.io/datevampires]itch.io[/url]]
